name: AIAvatar
description: Three concentric BRAND-blue circles with a white monogram. Exported at two sizes: AIAvatar (34px, with a glow) for hero identity, BotAvatar (18px, no glow) for inline attribution. Identical artwork; only size and shadow differ.
intent: The mark that tells a user a machine is speaking.

authority.note: src/ is authoritative. If this contract disagrees with the source, implement from the source and report the drift.

Do not recolor it, do not use currentColor, do not add a dark: variant, and do not add a gradient ring. A user learns this mark means "a machine produced this"; if it changes with theme or context it stops being recognisable. / const RINGS = ["#B4BDFF", "#5A6DFF", "#1F2A66"] as const interface AvatarMarkProps extends React.SVGProps<SVGSVGElement> { size?: number monogram?: string /** Hero treatment. requiredAttributes: label, unless an adjacent visible text label already names the agent
notes: Without a label the SVG is aria-hidden, which is right when it sits beside the agent name in ai:ai-message-header.
Standing alone — in ai:ai-agent-stack, say — it must carry a label naming the agent and its status.
The fixed fills are chosen for contrast against both light and dark chrome. Do not recolour them to "fix" dark mode.

forbiddenUsage: Adding a gradient or orange ring
Using it as a human avatar
agentRules: The palette is fixed. No currentColor, no dark: variants, no theme tokens, no gradient ring.
Both exports share the same artwork — only size and glow differ.
Label it when it stands alone; leave it aria-hidden beside a visible agent name.
Never use it for a human user.
